note: The Framework release the portal shell is served against, and the effects catalogue its pages place backgrounds from. Pages load ui from jsDelivr at ui.commit and the catalogue at effects.commit; SF.Effects checks every effect file against the catalogue's SHA-256. A repin changes this file only; take the pair from the release contract (contracts/releases/<pair>.lock.json in simai/ui), never from a branch head, and a catalogue commit that its Pages deployed.
